Hi Lauren / Grace —

Thanks for the packet. A couple clarifications from procurement and tax: 

• Vendor token: Aurora issues a static supplier code (example: AUR-000123). That code should be included on all invoices in the "Supplier Code" field. We will provision the code after the portal verification step.

• PO ACK: We prefer an automated HTTP ACK (your API endpoint) — a 202 response acknowledging acceptance is fine. ACK payload should include: Aurora PO number, supplier code, accepted / partial / reject status, and expected fulfillment ETA.

• Remit & cash application: Use ap-invoices@redwood.com as the remit contact inside the portal. For wire/ACH we will use the bank letter; please upload routing and beneficiary name.

• VAT: For EU shipments, include the buyer VAT (Aurora EU entity) and the phrase "Reverse charge - buyer liable for VAT". Sophie will reach out if she needs additional declarations.

• Payment terms: Standard NET45 accepted. Aurora has an early-payment program but that is optional and handled in a separate PO amendment.

We will create your supplier code within 24 hours of the portal submission. Once created, you will see a status change to "Active - PO routing enabled."

Regards,
